channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Houthi attacks on southern Saudi Arabia reportedly injure dozens
item.description: Saudi Arabia says a wave of Houthi attacks on the country’s south have injured 73 people, including women and children.

item.title: As fuel prices rise again, Iran’s government urges citizens to cut back
item.description: New fuel pricing targets consumption above 110 litres monthly, doubling costs to 100,000 riyals per litre.

item.title: Yemen fighting live: Battles rage between Houthi and Saudi-backed forces
item.description: Forces loyal to Yemen’s internationally recognised government pledge to seize the capital Sanaa as battles rage.

item.title: Palestine weekly: Israeli ministers push for depopulation of Gaza
item.description: Ethnic cleansing plans move from slogans to policy proposals, amid West Bank demolitions and mounting deaths in Gaza.

item.title: Saudi Arabia says 73 wounded as Houthis attack civilian and energy sites
item.description: Spokesperson for Saudi-led coalition says Houthis have hit civilian sites in Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jizan and Najran.

item.title: ‘House moved like jelly’ says resident near Bolivia barracks blast
item.description: Reports are emerging from the powerful explosion at a military barracks in Bolivia that killed at least nine people.

item.title: Russian strikes on Ukraine’s Kyiv kill at least two people
item.description: US envoy says 'encouraged' by talks as White House official told Reuters next steps to be announced in coming weeks.

item.title: Yemeni forces launch counteroffensive against Houthis, vow to retake Sanaa
item.description: Bid to take the capital comes as clashes between Yemeni forces and Houthis intensify in the provinces of al-Bayda and al-Jawf.

item.title: IAEA warns over Iran nuclear access as Western powers push UN referral
item.description: UN nuclear watchdog urges Iran to cooperate, as Western powers push to refer its nuclear file to the Security Council.

item.title: Iran war live: Qatar warns of ‘industrial catastrophe’ if crisis continues
item.description: An average of 10 ships transited Strait of Hormuz daily over past 10 days, the lowest level since May, Kpler data shows.
